newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-DORTMUND CLINCH DEAL WITH EXPERIENCED KOHLER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-DORTMUND CLINCH DEAL WITH EXPERIENCED KOHLER.

text.p: Borussia Dortmund sealed a crucial deal with their experienced defender Juergen Kohler on Friday as they prepared for Saturday's league clash at home with Borussia Moenchengladbach.

Dortmund have decided to take out an option to extend the German international's contract by one year until 1999. The defender, a member of the German 1990 World Cup-winning team, joined Dortmund from Italy's Juventus in 1995.

The 31-year-old Kohler retired from international football last year after being forced out of most of the European championship with injury. But he changed his mind and hopes to play in next year's World Cup finals in France.
